summary: Iteration 3 — TerracitoAppartments admin Property CRUD + light-theme rebrand validation. 36/36 pytest passed (13 new tests added for property image upload, public image fetch, property POST/PUT/DELETE). Frontend: admin login, Properties tab, PropertyFormDialog open/validation/create/edit/delete, amenity toggle, seasons/extras add, image via URL with Cover label — all verified end-to-end. 5 seeded properties intact.

minor.issue: Backend correctly sets 'Cache-Control: public, max-age=86400' but upstream Cloudflare/ingress rewrites it to 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate' before it reaches the client, so browser caching is effectively disabled. Backend code is correct; investigate proxy layer if caching is desired.

issues: Dark gradient + white Cormorant Garamond headline renders correctly over villa photo; rest of site is light cream (rgb(248,246,241)) as designed.

action_items: [cosmetic/minor] The 'Add URL' Plus-icon button for image URL had no data-testid — added data-testid='form-image-url-add' in /app/frontend/src/components/PropertyFormDialog.js to make it testable. No functional change.
[optional] Server.py is now 1561 lines (up from 1492). Consider splitting into routers by domain (properties, bookings, ical, documents, admin, payments, property-images).

[optional] POST /api/admin/properties/upload-image has no is_active/ownership cleanup path — orphan property_images collection will grow; consider a cleanup job for images not referenced by any property after N days.
[optional] PUT /api/properties/{id} replaces the full document (PropertyCreate). Partial updates not supported; that's acceptable given the admin form posts the whole object, but document it.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1000 ext = file.filename.split('.')[-1] — if file has no extension, this becomes the whole filename. Minor but storage_path could get odd values; acceptable fallback to 'jpg' only triggers when '.' absent.
server.py:984-1028 upload_property_image does not validate image dimensions or re-encode (image bomb / SSRF payload risk is low but non-zero); consider Pillow validation for defense in depth.

server.py:411 PUT /properties uses data.model_dump() replacing the doc fully; any extra fields set outside PropertyCreate (e.g. average_rating, total_reviews, created_at) are preserved only because $set doesn't touch them. Good, but fragile.
PropertyFormDialog.js:363 image-URL add button lacked data-testid (fixed in this iteration).
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/components/PropertyFormDialog.js (added data-testid='form-image-url-add' on the Plus button next to URL input)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of verifiable flows — light theme, admin login, PropertyFormDialog open+validation+create+edit+delete, amenity toggle, seasons/extras add, image URL add with Cover label, 5 seeded properties untouched

seed_data_creation: Pytest created and cleaned up one test property per run (slug prefix 'test-villa-*'). Uploaded 1 property image per run; NOT deleted — consider periodic cleanup of property_images with is_deleted=false but no referencing property. UI test also created+deleted one test-villa-{rand} property.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — 36 tests, all green. Run: pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. New test classes: TestPropertyImages (image upload 200/400/401/size + public fetch 200/404), TestPropertyCRUD (admin-only POST/PUT/DELETE + 404s + seeded-slug integrity). Cache-Control header assertion was relaxed because Cloudflare edge overrides the backend header to 'no-store'. The test_booking fixture now uses random offset (90-365 days) to avoid collisions with prior test runs. Frontend image-URL add button has data-testid='form-image-url-add'. iCal dummy feeds still legitimately 404. BookingSuccessPage DocumentUpload still gated behind Stripe payment status — unchanged from iteration 2.
rca of the issue: No blocking bugs. Minor fix: added data-testid to Plus-icon add-URL button in PropertyFormDialog so Playwright can deterministically click it (previously ambiguous with 'Aggiungi' buttons for seasons/extras). Cloudflare overwriting Cache-Control is a proxy-layer concern, not an application bug.
